caption: The drawing depicts a piece of fabric with a repeating ornamental pattern arranged in a horizontal composition. The background color is a light beige or off-white. There are large floral motifs in red and coral hues, with green leaves and stems scattered throughout. Some of the flowers are depicted in vases or cups, which are outlined and filled with a dark blue or indigo color; these vases have a stylized, geometric design. Along the left and bottom borders, there are scalloped, semi-circular arcs decorated with dotted blue lines and filled with orange triangular and quarter-circle shapes. The inner area contains a symmetrical arrangement of red and orange flowers of various styles and sizes, interspersed with green leafy branches. The pattern uses primarily red, orange, green, and blue on the light background, and the objects are systematically repeated to create a balanced, decorative effect.
title: Printed Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
